about: Signer ids allowed to sign keychain release records (tools/keychain-release): a bzpq1 id (SPEC-BPQ-1 §3b) or an mldsa65: id (bheart.signature/1 from bsigner, mldsa65:<base64url SHA3-256 of the ML-DSA-65 verifying key>). Empty until the founder rules who the release signer is. Never the law key in docs/PQ-SIGNERS.json; never a key derived from the skaists.dev wallet passkey.
